## Synopsis

Prints one row per tool, or one row per server when the outcome is server-wide.
STATUS is visible, approve_gated, hidden_policy, no_binding, matcher_miss or
not_running, and REASON says it in words. At least one --role or --user is required.

```
strazactl catalog preview [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  strazactl catalog preview --role scout-role --app scout-tools
  strazactl catalog preview --user nina-data-analyst-agent
```

## Options

```
      --app string         filter to one server
      --role stringArray   role to include in the subject (repeatable)
      --user string        resolve the subject from an existing username
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
